# @weight 3

busybox's sha3sum, its other digests on a file holding a NUL
(coreutils/md5_sha1_sum.c), and cryptpw, which is mkpasswd too
(loginutils/cryptpw.c).  Every expectation is busybox 1.36.1's own
output, in alpine, run as an ordinary user; its cryptpw hashes through
musl's crypt, sha512 when -m does not say.  A `|` marks the end of each
line written to standard output.

## the fixtures

### the files, which busybox made, and a run in a fresh directory

`abc` holds three bytes and no newline, `empty` none, `nul` five bytes
with two NULs among them and a newline, `long` 300; `pw`, `pw2`, `nonl`,
`blank` and `nopw` are passwords to read, a line, two lines, one with no
newline, an empty line and nothing.  Each run is in `/tmp/x-cu-cr/w`, made
afresh from them: PRE runs before the applet, POST after it, both through
the shell.

```cu
(do (proc-run (list "/bin/sh" "-c" "rm -rf /tmp/x-cu-cr && mkdir -p /tmp/x-cu-cr/w")) (def cr-f (fn (_ n) (string-append "/tmp/x-cu-cr/" n))) (file-write-all (cr-f "fx.b64") "") (proc-run (list "/bin/sh" "-c" "cd /tmp/x-cu-cr && base64 -d < fx.b64 > fx.tar")) (def cr-home (Sys getcwd)) (def cr-sh (fn (_ cmd out) (proc-run (list "/bin/sh" "-c" (string-concat (list "cd /tmp/x-cu-cr/w && { " cmd "; } > " out " 2>&1")))))) (def cr-in (fn (_ name) (if (string=? name "-") "" (let ((fd (file-open-read (string-append "/tmp/x-cu-cr/w/" name))) (buf (%str-make-raw 65536))) (let ((n (File read fd buf 65536))) (do (file-close fd) (pair buf n))))))) (def cr-norm (fn (_ f) (do (proc-run (list "/bin/sh" "-c" (string-concat (list "sed -E 's#[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}#TIME#' " f " > " f ".n")))) (file-read-all (string-append f ".n"))))) (def cr-shown (fn (_ mode) (if (string=? mode "x") (do (proc-run (list "/bin/sh" "-c" "od -An -v -tx1 /tmp/x-cu-cr/o | tr -d ' \\n' | fold -w 64 > /tmp/x-cu-cr/hex; echo >> /tmp/x-cu-cr/hex")) (file-read-all (cr-f "hex"))) (Str8 replace "\n" "|\n" (cr-norm (cr-f "o")))))) (def cr-case (fn (_ fresh in pre post mode argv) (do (if fresh (cr-sh "cd /tmp/x-cu-cr && rm -rf w && mkdir w && cd w && tar xf ../fx.tar" "/dev/null") ()) (if (string=? pre "@") () (cr-sh pre "/dev/null")) (def cr-stdin (cr-in in)) (Sys chdir "/tmp/x-cu-cr/w") (sys-dup2 1 9) (sys-dup2 2 8) (def st (let ((oo (file-open-write (cr-f "o"))) (ee (file-open-write (cr-f "e")))) (do (sys-dup2 oo 1) (sys-dup2 ee 2) (def rs (cu-run argv cr-stdin)) (sys-dup2 9 1) (sys-dup2 8 2) (file-close oo) (file-close ee) rs))) (Sys chdir cr-home) (display (string-concat (list (cr-shown mode) "stderr:\n" (file-read-all (cr-f "e")) "status " (%cu-int->str st) "\n" (if (string=? post "@") "" (do (cr-sh post (cr-f "p")) (string-append "after:\n" (file-read-all (cr-f "p"))))))))))) (display "made"))
```
---
    made

## sha3sum

### each file's SHA3, 224 bits unless -a says otherwise, - standard input, a file past one block


### -c checks each line's digest at the width -a gives; -s says nothing, -w warns of a line that is not one

```cu
(do (cr-case #t "-" "printf '3a985da74fe225b2045c172d6bd390bd855f086e3e9d525b46bfe24511431532  abc\\n' > sums" "@" "-" (list "sha3sum" "-a" "256" "-c" "sums")) (cr-case #t "-" "printf '3a985da74fe225b2045c172d6bd390bd855f086e3e9d525b46bfe24511431532  abc\\n' > sums" "@" "-" (list "sha3sum" "-c" "sums")) (cr-case #t "-" "printf '3a985da74fe225b2045c172d6bd390bd855f086e3e9d525b46bfe24511431532  abc\\nnot a line\\n' > sums" "@" "-" (list "sha3sum" "-a" "256" "-c" "-w" "sums")) (cr-case #t "-" "printf '0000  abc\\n' > sums" "@" "-" (list "sha3sum" "-a" "256" "-c" "-s" "sums")))
```

## a salt made at random

### without one, the salt is crypt's base-64 from /dev/urandom, as many characters as the method takes, and the hash agrees with itself

Each answer is the length written, without its newline; its first three
characters, or des for a DES hash; and whether hashing the password again
with it as the salt gives it back.

```cu
(do (def cr-run (fn (_ argv)
      (do (sys-dup2 1 9)
          (def o (file-open-write (cr-f "r")))
          (sys-dup2 o 1)
          (cu-run argv "")
          (sys-dup2 9 1) (file-close o)
          (let ((s (file-read-all (cr-f "r")))) (substring s 0 (- (byte-len s) 1))))))
    (def cr-shape (fn (_ s) (list (byte-len s) (if (Str8 starts? "$" s) (substring s 0 3) "des") (string=? (%cu-pw-encrypt "pw" s) s))))
    (display (map (fn (_ m) (cr-shape (cr-run (list "cryptpw" "-m" m "pw")))) (list "des" "md5" "sha256" "sha512")))
    (newline)
    (display (cr-shape (cr-run (list "mkpasswd" "pw")))))
```
---
```output
((13 des #t) (34 $1$ #t) (63 $5$ #t) (106 $6$ #t))
(106 $6$ #t)
```
